newsitem.title: UK: Nursing Homes raises credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Nursing Homes raises credit facility.

text.p: Nursing Home Properties Plc said on Friday it agreed with Bank of Scotland to up its three-year revolving credit facility to 71.8 million stg from 20 million stg.
The property investment company also said it appointed NatWest Markets to arrange the securitisation of about 100 million stg of nursing home properties.
The securitisation follows a Nursing Homes review, which looked into ways to fix the costs of the firm's long-term borrowings.
Additionally, Nursing Homes, which specialises in buying and leasing back modern purpose-built homes, announced it had closed its U.S. offer, which raised 9.65 million stg.
The total raised from the placing and open offer, the U.S. offer and the subscription from Meditrust was 26.65 million stg before expenses.
The money will be used to buy the 100 million stg portfolio of nursing homes required to carry out the securitisation.
